items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stitt and Daughtry: Was that the Theresa? Hotel Theresa? The Theresa, yeah.

ctx.x: I don’t know what they did in New York, because we – when we got off the bus – we took the bus from Chicago to New York. When we got off the bus, we had $5 between us. But we stayed in the hotel right behind the theater. Stitt and Daughtry: Was that the Theresa? Hotel Theresa?
